scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA14) of two current dossiers: TJX, SO. 14 load-bearing facts checked (7/7 by ticker), selected for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: headline quarterly figures, guidance track record, debt/leverage and balance-sheet items, capital returns, litigation/red-flag scan, and multi-entity/period scoping. Special attention paid to TJX's late-January fiscal year-end (every period label re-derived from the primary source's own 13/26-week fiscal captions, not assumed from the dossier's labels) and to SO's status as a multi-registrant filer (Southern Company parent plus Georgia Power, Alabama Power, Mississippi Power, Southern Power and Southern Company Gas all filed under one combined 10-Q/10-K/8-K) -- every SO figure below was cross-checked against the 'Southern' (consolidated parent), not a subsidiary, financial-statement tab of the combined filing. v4/outputs/dossier_precheck.json and v4/outputs/xbrl_crosstie.json were read for both tickers: both list empty flags arrays for TJX and SO (no pre-flagged lines to carry forward). Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99/Ex-99.1 earnings-release exhibits, 10-Q full text and R-file XBRL-rendered exhibits -- fetched directly from www.sec.gov with a compliant User-Agent header at <=2 requests/second and cached locally. Both dossiers were read to their end (no appended Correction sections were found on either). Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings.

facts.claim: Q2 FY2027 (13 weeks ended 2026-08-01) headline: net sales $15.2bn (+5% YoY); consolidated comparable sales +4%; gross profit margin 33.4% (+2.7pts YoY), adjusted gross margin 31.4% (+0.7pt ex tariff-refund benefit); GAAP diluted EPS $1.36 (+24% YoY); adjusted diluted EPS $1.22 (+11% YoY, excluding a $0.14 net tariff-refund benefit)
facts.dossier_location: TJX.md §4 (narrative paragraph and results table, Q2 FY27 row)
facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, accession 0000109198-26-000045, filed 2026-08-19
facts.source_value: "Net sales for the second quarter of Fiscal 2027 were $15.2 billion, an increase of 5%"; "Second quarter Fiscal 2027 consolidated comparable sales increased 4%"; "Gross profit margin ... was 33.4%, up 2.7 percentage points versus last year's 30.7%"; "adjusted gross profit margin was 31.4%, up 0.7 percentage points"; "diluted earnings per share were $1.36, up 24% versus $1.10"; "adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.22, up 11% versus the prior year"
facts.note: Exact match on every figure in this fact.

facts.claim: Net income for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-08-01) was $1,243mn, per the dossier's own results table (§4, 'Q2 FY27 (Aug '26 q, press release)' row, labelled '1,243 (NI, XBRL)')
facts.dossier_location: TJX.md §4 results table, Q2 FY27 row
facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, Financial Summary table, accession 0000109198-26-000045; and TJX Q2 FY2027 10-Q, accession 0000109198-26-000048, Consolidated Statements of Income
facts.source_value: "Net income $1,520" for the Thirteen Weeks Ended August 1, 2026 (i.e., Q2 FY2027); "$1,243" in the same table is the comparative Thirteen Weeks Ended August 2, 2025 figure -- i.e., Q2 FY2026 (the PRIOR-year quarter), not Q2 FY2027
facts.note: TJX's fiscal-year labelling trap: the dossier's results table mislabels the prior-year (Q2 FY2026, quarter ended 2026-08-02-2025) net income of $1,243mn as if it were the current Q2 FY2027 net income. The correct Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-08-01) net income is $1,520mn -- a $277mn (~18%) understatement. This does not affect the dossier's EPS figures, guidance table, or verdict (which correctly use $1.36 GAAP / $1.22 adjusted EPS and other Q2 FY27 metrics elsewhere), but the standalone net-income cell in the results table is wrong and should be corrected to $1,520mn.

facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, "Comparable Sales by Division" table, accession 0000109198-26-000045
facts.source_value: Second Quarter Comparable Sales FY2027: Marmaxx (U.S.) +1%; HomeGoods (U.S.) +7%; TJX Canada +6%; TJX International (Europe & Australia) +7%; TJX +4%. CEO quote: "While sales at Marmaxx were below our expectations, HomeGoods, TJX Canada, and TJX International all delivered terrific comp sales increases of 6% to 7%"

facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, "Third Quarter, Full Year Fiscal 2027, and Store Growth Outlook" section, accession 0000109198-26-000045
facts.source_value: "The Company is increasing its full-year diluted earnings per share outlook to be in the range of $5.31 to $5.36. Excluding an expected net benefit of $.16 from tariff refunds, the Company is increasing its full year outlook for adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.15 to $5.20."

facts.claim: Balance sheet, consolidated TJX, 2026-08-01: long-term debt $1.87bn (down from $2.87bn a year earlier); cash and cash equivalents $6.00bn (up from $4.64bn); shareholders' equity $10.65bn (up from $8.87bn)
facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, "Condensed Balance Sheets" exhibit, accession 0000109198-26-000045 (identical figures also in the Q2 FY2027 10-Q, accession 0000109198-26-000048)
facts.source_value: "Long-term debt $1,871" (Aug 1, 2026) vs "$2,867" (Aug 2, 2025); "Cash and cash equivalents $6,004" vs "$4,639"; "Shareholders' equity $10,651" vs "$8,866" (all in millions)
facts.note: Exact match on all three balance-sheet figures and both periods. Note the balance sheet also shows a separate $1,000mn 'Current portion of long-term debt' line not mentioned in the dossier's long-term-debt figure -- this is a completeness gap, not an error (the dossier's $1.87bn figure correctly matches the 'Long-term debt' line item as labelled), but total consolidated debt including the current portion is $2.87bn, not $1.87bn.

facts.claim: Q2 FY2027 shareholder returns: $798mn of buybacks (5.1mn shares) plus $529mn of dividends in the quarter, funded from operating cash flow
facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, "Cash and Shareholder Distributions" section and Note 2, accession 0000109198-26-000045
facts.source_value: "The Company repurchased 5.1 million shares of TJX stock for a total of $798 million and paid $529 million in shareholder dividends"; "the Company generated $2.2 billion of operating cash flow and ended the quarter with $6.0 billion of cash"
facts.note: Exact match on shares repurchased, dollar amount and dividends paid.

facts.claim: Red-flag scan / kill-criterion-1 consistency: no material 2026 litigation identified (Item 1 Legal Proceedings refers only to immaterial ordinary-course matters); the 8-K Item 5.02 filed 2026-09-17 (accession 0000109198-26-000051) is a benign board addition, not an executive departure; Marmaxx comp sales (+1% in Q2 FY27) have been below the 2%-comp kill-criterion threshold for only one quarter, not the two consecutive quarters needed to trip kill criterion 1 (Marmaxx was +6% in Q1 FY27)
facts.source: TJX Q2 FY2027 10-Q, Item 1 Legal Proceedings and Note K, accession 0000109198-26-000048; 8-K Item 5.02, accession 0000109198-26-000051, filed 2026-09-17; TJX Q1 FY2027 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99.1, accession 0000109198-26-000023, filed 2026-05-20
facts.source_value: 10-Q: "TJX is subject to certain legal proceedings ... TJX has accrued immaterial amounts"; no going-concern, restatement or material-weakness language found. 8-K: "the Board of Directors ... elected Craig A. Pintoff as a member of the Company's Board and of its Audit and Finance Committee, effective immediately" -- an addition, not a departure. Q1 FY2027 release: "Marmaxx (U.S.) +6%" (comparable sales), versus +3% in Q1 FY2026
facts.note: The dossier's kill criterion 1 and its own stated 'current run-rate: +1%' framing (singular quarter, not 'two consecutive') are consistent with the primary sources: Marmaxx was +6% in Q1 FY2027, so only Q2 FY2027 (+1%) is currently below the 2% threshold. The 8-K item 5.02 the dossier flagged as a gap resolves as a routine, non-adverse independent-director addition (Craig Pintoff, EVP/CAO of United Rentals) with no related-party disclosures -- no departure, compensatory dispute or governance red flag found.

facts.claim: Q2 2026 (three months ended 2026-06-30) headline, consolidated Southern Company: operating revenues $6.98bn (+0.1% YoY, essentially flat); GAAP EPS $1.03 vs $0.80 a year earlier (+29%); adjusted ("excluding items") EPS $1.13 vs $0.92 a year earlier (+23%)
facts.dossier_location: SO.md §4 (results table, Q2 2026 row and narrative)
facts.source: SO Q2 2026 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99, accession 0000092122-26-000056, filed 2026-07-30
facts.source_value: "Southern Company today reported second-quarter earnings of $1.2 billion, or $1.03 per share, in 2026 compared with earnings of $0.9 billion, or $0.80 per share, in the second quarter of 2025"; "Southern Company earned $1.3 billion, or $1.13 per share ... compared with ... $0.92 per share"; "Second-quarter 2026 operating revenues were $6.98 billion, compared with $6.97 billion for the second quarter of 2025, an increase of 0.1%". Financial Highlights page: Southern Company Operating Revenues $6,977 vs $6,973 -- distinct from the same page's Alabama Power ($1,963), Georgia Power ($3,133) and Mississippi Power ($403) subsidiary revenue lines in the same release
facts.note: Exact match on every headline figure. Entity scoping confirmed correct: the dossier's Q2 2026 figures are the consolidated 'Southern Company' line of the earnings release, not any of the Alabama Power/Georgia Power/Mississippi Power/Southern Power/Southern Company Gas segment or subsidiary lines shown separately on the same Financial Overview page -- no conflation found.

facts.claim: Stockholders' equity (consolidated): $36.0bn at 2025-12-31 (10-K), up from $33.2bn a year earlier
facts.source: SO FY2025 10-K, "Consolidated Balance Sheets - Southern" exhibit (R8.htm), accession 0000092122-26-000006, filed 2026-02-19
facts.note: Exact match, correctly labelled as common stockholders' equity. Note this excludes noncontrolling interests ($2,851mn at Dec-25): the 10-K's broader 'Total stockholders' equity' line (common equity + NCI) is $38,867mn at Dec-25 and $36,674mn at Dec-24 -- a different, larger figure than the dossier's $36.0bn/$33.2bn. The dossier's own label ('stockholders' equity,' without specifying 'common') is slightly loose given SO discloses both a common-only and an all-in total, but the numbers it cites are the common-equity figures and match that line exactly, so this is not scored as an error.

facts.claim: SO's Q2 2026 press release does not restate a full-year 2026 EPS guidance range; confirmed content is management's reference to continuing data-center demand and to a tax remeasurement tied to the resolved Vogtle 3/4 loss estimate (not new construction overruns)
facts.source: SO Q2 2026 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99, accession 0000092122-26-000056
facts.source_value: No FY2026 EPS guidance range appears anywhere in the release. CEO quote: "Across the Southeast, extraordinary economic development momentum and demand for power continue to create meaningful opportunities". Footnote (5): "Earnings include income tax charges of $4 million ... related to the remeasuring of deferred tax assets associated with the previously recognized estimated probable loss on Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 due to changes in the State of Georgia corporate tax rate"
facts.note: Confirmed: the primary source contains no FY2026 point EPS guidance range (consistent with the dossier's own flagged gap/medium-confidence framing on the guidance track record) and the only Vogtle-related item in the release is the described tax remeasurement, not a new cost overrun -- exactly as the dossier states.

facts.claim: Red-flag scan: no new 2026 SEC or DOJ investigation found; no going-concern language, material-weakness disclosure or restatement identified in the Q2 2026 10-Q; historical Kemper-related SEC investigation/class action and 2022 Deloitte class action are legacy matters unrelated to Vogtle or current operating segments
facts.source: SO Q2 2026 10-Q (combined multi-registrant filing), Item 1/Item 1A, accession 0000092122-26-000054, filed 2026-07-30
facts.source_value: Item 1: "See the Notes to the Condensed Financial Statements herein for information regarding certain legal and administrative proceedings"; Item 1A: "There have been no material changes to these risk factors". Full-text search of the 10-Q for "Kemper", "material weakness", "going concern" and "restat[ement]" returned zero matches
facts.note: Confirmed: the current Q2 2026 10-Q discloses no new SEC/DOJ matter, no going-concern language, no material weakness and no restatement, and does not even mention Kemper -- consistent with the dossier's characterization of Kemper as a resolved, legacy matter outside the current filing's disclosures.

facts.claim: Thesis/kill-criterion-1 consistency: adjusted EPS growth of +23% (Q2 2026) / +14.4% (H1 2026 YTD) is far above the kill criterion 1 threshold (adjusted EPS growth falling below 4% for two consecutive quarters, vs the ~5-7% long-term target)
facts.source: SO Q2 2026 earnings press release, 8-K Ex-99, accession 0000092122-26-000056
facts.source_value: "Southern Company earned $1.3 billion, or $1.13 per share ... compared with ... $0.92 per share" (+22.8%); "$2.8 billion ... $2.46 per share" YTD vs "$2.4 billion ... $2.15 per share" (+14.4%)
facts.note: Thesis (Vogtle risk resolved, data-center upside not yet priced) and kill criterion 1 are internally consistent with the primary-source figures verified above; adjusted EPS growth is running well above both the long-term 5-7% target and the <4% kill threshold, and no contradiction was found.
